landing.heroTitle: ASIC monitoring for farms that want to scale.
landing.heroBody: A headless collector runs on your farm's PC, reads your machines on the local network and sends the data to the cloud. Compatible with Antminer, Whatsminer and Avalon — manage your whole fleet, from any manufacturer, in a single hub. Track hash rate, temperature and availability of any device, with a license per active machine.
landing.featureCollectionBody: Headless executable, no ports opened on the farm.
landing.featureAccessBody: Team and clients access the same panel from any browser.
landing.featureLicenseBody: Monthly subscription at US$ 1.00 per active ASIC.
landing.featureCompatBody: Machines from any manufacturer, in a single management hub — no switching panels.
landing.howItWorksBody: From account creation to a live panel, in four steps.
landing.step1: Create your account and register the farm.
landing.step2: Download and install the collector on the main PC.
landing.step3: Register the ASICs by local IP address.
landing.step4: Track hash rate and alerts in real time.

collector.title: Telemetry
collector.description: Install once on each farm's main computer.
collector.linuxBody: Terminal version (no window) of the same collector, with a systemd service to start on its own at every boot. The package includes the install script and instructions.
collector.heroTitle: Connects your local network to the cloud securely
collector.heroBody: A windowed app protected by its own machine login. Scans the network or registers IPs manually, sends telemetry and applies pool changes and reboots requested from the panel. No farm port needs to stay exposed.
collector.step1Body: Register the location and open the monitoring page.
collector.step2Body: On the farm page, open “Telemetry” and generate a credential.
collector.step3Body: Create the local login, paste the URL and the token in Cloud settings.
collector.step4Body: Scan the network or add the IP manually — it syncs instantly with the panel.
collector.readyBody: Pick a farm, open the “Telemetry” button and copy the install token.
